verdict.rationale: Cognee is open source and can be run entirely locally or on your own infrastructure (Docker, `cognee.start_ui()`), giving users full control over where their data physically resides, and dataset-scoped permissions provide isolation. However, there is no explicit region/residency selection feature for the hosted Cognee Cloud offering (e.g., choosing a data center region), so residency control is only achieved indirectly via self-hosting rather than as a first-class configurable option. Missing for 10: explicit region-selection controls for the cloud product, and any documentation of data residency guarantees/compliance certifications.
